title: Methylprednisolone Taper is an Effective Addition to Multimodal Pain Regimens After Rotator Cuff Repair
official: Methylprednisolone Taper is an Effective Addition to Multimodal Pain Regimens After Rotator Cuff Repair
summary: The use of Methylprednisolone Taper will be investigated in the setting of a Rotator Cuff Repair to determine if it will result in lower pain levels following surgery
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* undergoing a rotator cuff repair.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with concurrent and significant injury to other bones or organs
* a history of alcohol or substance abuse
* a history of severe heart disease
* a history of renal failure, a history of liver dysfunction
* active peptic ulcer disease
* neurological or psychiatric diseases that may affect pain perception
* active pregnancy
* uncontrolled diabetes mellitus

sites.f: Steadman Hawkins Clinic of the Carolinas, Prisma Health
